$comment: Third-party libraries for the docs About page (<LibraryTable />, doc/credits.md) and custom_components/lcards/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Hand-written: what package.json cannot say. Versions and licenses are read from node_modules/<pkg>/package.json (scripts/lib/third-party.js), never typed here. `packages` are the package.json dependencies a row stands for; `family` the transitive packages that land in the bundle with them; `license` overrides the package.json license for display (needs `licenseNote`); `load` is main (the main chunk, every page) or lazy (a chunk loaded on demand). tests/docs/third-party.test.js keeps this in step with src/ imports, package.json and the built sourcemaps.
